params.message:
A knock to repair or read says so and links to the button that answers it

A knock for a layer (B2 repair, B1 read) is answered only by that layer's own
admission on the project page; WorkbenchRequest::answer closes the knocks of the
layer admitted and no others. The werkbank page listed such a knock under a
checkbox it ticked, and that checkbox admits proposals. Admitting the selection
answered the proposal knock beside it and left the repair knock standing for its
whole day, so the approval looked as if it had not taken.

- workbench page: a layered knock reads "asks to repair" (or "asks to read"),
  without the "[repair]" tag in its reason, with a link to the project page where
  its button is, and no longer ticks the proposals checkbox on its own
- owner state (the phone and the overview): the same sentence, and its link goes
  to the project page instead of /portal/werkbank
- WorkbenchRequest::answeredOnProjectPage, layerWord and plainReason
- Dutch translations for the new strings
